name: io.github.edsonvmendes/miniframe-tools
description: Brazilian tools for agents: Pix codes, CEP, CNPJ + web capture and PDF. Pay per call.

environmentVariables.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a wallet on Base funded with a small amount of USDC, used to sign per-call payments locally. Use a dedicated low-balance wallet; the key is never sent to the API.

environmentVariables.name: MINIFRAME_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://tools.miniframe.com.br
